name: TopBar
purpose: The application's global header: brand, optional centre content and actions. Not a page title; that is PageHeader.
description: A sticky banner landmark on surface layer-1 with a bottom border. Its height is size.topbar (56px comfortable, 48px compact), which sticky elements below it use as their offset. Content is passed through three slots.

brand.description: Product mark and name, usually a link to home.

children.description: Centre content such as a search field or an environment switcher.

actions.description: Right-aligned actions: help, notifications, theme toggle, account. Use ghost icon-only Buttons.

a11y.role: banner (header element at the top level)
a11y.name: Not named; there is one banner per page.
notes: The TopBar is not focusable itself; its brand link and action buttons are.
Sticky content below it offsets by top-topbar so it is never obscured (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.11).

rules: One TopBar per page, placed in AppShell's topBar slot.
Actions are ghost Buttons; icon-only actions need aria-label.
Never put the page title in the TopBar; that belongs to PageHeader.
dos: Link the brand to the product home.
donts: Do not add a primary Button to the TopBar; primary actions belong to the page.
